brand.name: Fanwaner
brand.tagline: Broke? Put out a meal and let someone buy it for you.
brand.footerNote1: Money never passes through us — it goes straight to the person asking.
brand.footerNote2: We only keep one record: who got fed today.

create.title: Ask for a meal — Fanwaner
create.metaDesc: Say what you need, plainly. Put out the bowl and wait for someone kind.
create.heading: 🍔 Ask for a meal
create.lead: Say what you actually need. No fluff.
create.fieldTitlePh: e.g. Just trying to get a burger today
create.fieldWant: What do you want to eat?
create.fieldWantPh: Be specific so people know how to help. e.g. Just moved cities and I'm broke — I'd kill for a proper burger and fries.
create.fieldReasonPh: Server bill is due / between jobs / just want someone to buy me lunch. Tell the truth.
create.fieldTargetHint: Keep it reasonable — a burger, not a banquet.
create.fieldDeadlineHint: Leave it empty to keep it open.
create.fieldPayHint: Optional — leave it blank if you just want a meal, no strings.
create.fieldSlugHint: Optional — random if empty. 3-20 chars: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.
create.successSub: Now we just need one kind soul to chip in.
create.copyManage: 🔑 Copy manage link (save it, don't lose it)
create.copyTip: Link copied. Go show it to your friends.
create.manageTip: Manage link copied. Stash it in your notes — open it from any browser to edit your request and approve contributions.
create.editLead: Money already collected stays put — you're only changing the content.
create.editJump: → Skip editing, go to the manage page (approve / copy link)
create.editMinHint: Already received {amount} — the goal can't be lower.
create.imgTooSmall: That image is a bit small — the QR code may be hard to scan. Try a sharper one.
create.errWant: Say what you want to eat.
create.errReason: Tell people why you need it.
create.errAmount: The goal must be greater than 0.
create.errAmountMax: Keep it reasonable — {max} is the cap.
create.errNickname: You need to leave a name.
create.errBep20: Invalid BEP20 address — 0x followed by 40 hex characters.
create.errErc20: Invalid ERC20 address — 0x followed by 40 hex characters.
create.errPaypal: That PayPal link or email doesn't look right.
create.errStripe: Enter a valid Stripe payment link (https://…).
create.errBmc: Enter a valid Buy Me a Coffee URL.
create.errWise: Enter a valid Wise email or link.
create.errNtfy: A topic can only contain letters, numbers, dashes and underscores.
create.errPushover: Pushover keys are 30 characters of letters and numbers.
create.errEmailApiUrl: The email API URL must start with https://.
create.errEmailApiKey: That email API key looks wrong.
create.errEmailFrom: Sender should be an email, or "Name <email>".
create.errSlug: Handle can only use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens — 3 to 20 characters.

pay.qrHint: Without an image, supporters can't scan it
pay.uploadTip: Upload a {name} QR code — auto-converted to webp, max 2MB
pay.addrWarn: Double-check the address before sending. If it's wrong, nobody can get it back.
pay.linkHint: A {name} link or your email — either works

notify.title: 🔔 New-contribution alerts
notify.hint: Get pinged the moment someone leaves a note (optional)
notify.wecomHint: Add a group bot in WeChat, then copy the webhook URL
notify.telegramHint: No bot needed — the platform bot sends it. Get your chat_id from @userinfobot, and send /start to the platform bot once first.
notify.serverchanHint: Get it at sct.ftqq.com, pushes to your WeChat
notify.discordHint: Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy URL
notify.slackHint: Slack App → Incoming Webhooks → Add New Webhook to Workspace
notify.ntfyHint: Pick any topic name, then subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Self-hosted servers supported via NTFY_API.
notify.pushoverHint: Create an app at pushover.net to get a token; your user key is on the dashboard.
notify.webhookHint: Any https endpoint (Zapier / Make / n8n / your own). We POST a JSON payload.
notify.emailBoxHint: Two parts: the address that receives, and the service that sends.
notify.emailToHint: Gmail / Outlook / anything works. This is just the recipient.
notify.emailNote: The sender below: alert emails are sent by an email API you configure — we never touch your mailbox password. We recommend resend.com (free tier, no card) → create an API key starting with re_ and paste it below.
notify.emailApiUrlHint: If you use Resend, keep the default
notify.emailApiKeyHint: Create one in Resend, starts with re_. Leave blank to keep the current one.
notify.footerHint: Fill in any of these — or all of them. Alerts fire the moment a note arrives. Only you can see this info; it's never public.

bowl.noPaymentToast: They haven't set up a payout method yet — send good vibes instead.
bowl.methodMissingToast: They didn't provide this payment method.
bowl.successSubPending: The owner will approve it before it shows up.
bowl.amountRequired: Enter an amount — any amount works.
bowl.nameRequired: Leave a name, or tick anonymous.
bowl.scanTip: Scan it and you're good to go.
bowl.addrOnly: Address only, no QR — send to the address above.
bowl.noQrNoLink: No QR image and no link provided…
bowl.loadFailedSub: This request seems to be missing.
